The same Ramsey fringes at four detunings,

$$
P_{|1\rangle}(t)=\frac12+\frac12\exp(-t/T_2^{*})\cos(2\pi\delta t)
$$

with $T_2^{*}=3\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ and shot noise for 2000 repetitions. These are synthetic
examples, not a device measurement. Screen is interactive. Print is static.
The page's light or dark mode selects the matching figure. The four traces
use the Embla palette for five or fewer series.

## Screen

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
from review import display_figure, for_renderings, lines, show

for_renderings(lambda appearance: show(lines(), reading="screen", appearance=appearance))
```

## Print

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
for_renderings(lambda appearance: show(lines(), reading="print", appearance=appearance))
```

## Pulse sequence

A schematic 40 ns interaction window. The vertical axis indicates relative
frequency only. The legend sits on the right in wide containers and below
the plot, aligned left, in narrow containers.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| renderings: [light, dark]
from quantum import pulse, curves
from design import CONFIG
for_renderings(lambda mode: display_figure(pulse(dark=mode == "dark"), config=CONFIG))
```
